title.zh: 卷四十二 志第十二: 曆象志上
title.raw: 卷四十二 志第十二: 曆象志上 Volume 42 Treatises 12: Celestial Phenomena 1

sentences.zh: 曆象誌上

translations.literal: Celestial Phenomena Treatise, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Phenomena Treatise I

sentences.zh: 遼以幽、營立國，禮樂制度，規模日完，授歷頒朔二百餘年。

translations.literal: The Liao founded their state on You and Ying; rites, music, and institutions grew daily more complete, and for more than two hundred years they transmitted the calendar and issued the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao rose from You and Ying; as ritual and institutions matured, they issued calendars and set the new moon for over two hundred years.

sentences.zh: 今奉詔修遼史，體與宋、金似，其《大明曆》不可少也。

translations.literal: Now, by imperial order we compile the History of Liao; its form resembles the Song and Jin histories, and the Great Brightness Calendar cannot be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to compile the History of Liao on the model of the Song and Jin histories, we cannot omit the Great Brightness Calendar.

sentences.zh: 歷書法禁不可得，求《大明曆》元，得祖沖之法於外史。

translations.literal: The calendrical methods were forbidden and unobtainable; seeking the epoch of the Great Brightness Calendar, we obtained Zu Chongzhi's methods in an external history.
translations.idiomatic: Official calendrical methods were barred from circulation; in seeking the Great Brightness epoch we found Zu Chongzhi's procedures in an outside history.

sentences.zh: 沖之之法，遼歷之所從出也歟？

translations.literal: Were Chongzhi's methods what the Liao calendar derived from?
translations.idiomatic: Did the Liao calendar ultimately derive from Chongzhi's methods?

sentences.zh: 國朝亦嘗因之。

translations.literal: Our dynasty also once followed them.
translations.idiomatic: The present dynasty too once adopted them.

sentences.zh: 以沖之法算，而至於遼更歷之年，以起元數，是蓋遼《大明曆》。

translations.literal: Calculating by Chongzhi's methods up to the year the Liao revised the calendar, and taking the epoch count from that, this is the Liao Great Brightness Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Working forward with Chongzhi's arithmetic to the Liao calendar reform and deriving the epoch from that point yields the Liao Great Brightness Calendar.

sentences.zh: 遼歷因是固可補，然弗之補，史貴闕文也。

translations.literal: The Liao calendar could indeed be supplemented on this basis, yet it is not supplemented; histories value lacunae in the text.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao calendar could be reconstructed from this material, but we leave it unreconstructed, for histories prize deliberate gaps.

sentences.zh: 外史紀其法，司天存其職，《遼史》誌是足矣。

translations.literal: The external history records its methods; the Directorate of Astronomy preserves its duties; for the History of Liao, this treatise suffices.
translations.idiomatic: An outside history records the procedures, the Directorate of Astronomy keeps the office, and this treatise in the History of Liao is enough.

sentences.zh: 作《歷象志》。

translations.literal: Thus the Calendar and Celestial Phenomena Treatise was composed.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the Calendar and Celestial Phenomena Treatise.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝大明六年，祖沖之上《甲子元曆》法，未及施用，因名《大明曆》。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Emperor Wu of Song's Daming reign, Zu Chongzhi submitted the methods of the Jiazi Epoch Calendar, which had not yet been put into use; it was therefore named the Great Brightness Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: In Song Daming year 6 (462 CE) Zu Chongzhi presented the Jiazi Epoch Calendar methods; before adoption they were called the Great Brightness Calendar.

sentences.zh: 上元甲子至宋大明七年癸卯，五萬一千九百三十九年算外。

translations.literal: From the upper origin jiazi to the seventh year of Song Daming, guimao, is 51,939 years, outside the count.
translations.idiomatic: From upper-origin jiazi to Song Daming year 7 (guimao) is 51,939 years beyond the epoch count.

sentences.zh: 推朔術：

translations.literal: Procedure for computing new moons:
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to compute new moons:

sentences.zh: 置入上元年數算外，以章月乘之，滿章歲為積月，不盡為閏餘。

translations.literal: Set in the upper-origin year count, outside the count; multiply by rule months; when full of rule years it makes accumulated months; what does not fill is intercalary remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Take the years since upper origin (outside the count), multiply by rule months, divide by rule years for accumulated months; the remainder is intercalary remainder.

sentences.zh: 閏餘二百四十七以上，其年有閏。

translations.literal: When intercalary remainder is 247 or more, that year has an intercalation.
translations.idiomatic: If intercalary remainder is 247 or above, the year has a leap month.

sentences.zh: 以月法乘積月，滿日法為積日，不盡為小餘。

translations.literal: Multiply accumulated months by the month factor; when full of the day factor it makes accumulated days; what does not fill is small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply accumulated months by the month factor; divide by the day factor for accumulated days; the remainder is fractional day remainder (xiao yu).

sentences.zh: 六旬去積日，不盡為大餘。

translations.literal: Remove six decades from accumulated days; what does not fill is greater remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract full sixty-day cycles from accumulated days; the remainder is greater remainder (da yu).

sentences.zh: 大餘命以甲子，算外，所求年天正十一月朔也。

translations.literal: Name greater remainder from jiazi, outside the count: that is the new moon of the eleventh month of the civil year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count greater remainder from jiazi (outside the count) to obtain the new moon of civil month 11 for the target year.

sentences.zh: 小餘千八百四十九以上，其月大。

translations.literal: When small remainder is 1,849 or more, that month is long (thirty days).
translations.idiomatic: If fractional day remainder is 1,849 or more, the month is a long month (30 days).

sentences.zh: 求次月：

translations.literal: To seek the next month:
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month:

sentences.zh: 加大餘二十九，小餘二千九十。

translations.literal: Add to greater remainder 29; to small remainder 2,090.
translations.idiomatic: Add 29 to greater remainder and 2,090 to fractional day remainder.

sentences.zh: 小餘滿日法從大餘，大餘滿六旬去之，命如前，次月朔也。

translations.literal: When small remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; when greater remainder fills six decades, remove it; name as before: the next month's new moon.
translations.idiomatic: When fractional remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; when greater remainder fills sixty days, drop it and name as before for the next new moon.

sentences.zh: 求弦望：

translations.literal: To seek first and full moon:
translations.idiomatic: To find first quarter and full moon:

sentences.zh: 加朔大餘七，小餘千五百七，小分一。

translations.literal: Add to new-moon greater remainder 7; to small remainder 1,507; to small parts 1.
translations.idiomatic: Add 7 to new-moon greater remainder, 1,507 to small remainder, and 1 to small parts.

sentences.zh: 小分滿四從小餘，小餘滿日法從大餘，命如前，上弦日也。

translations.literal: When small parts fill 4, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before: the first-quarter day.
translations.idiomatic: When small parts reach 4, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills the day factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before for first quarter.

sentences.zh: 又加得望，又加得下弦，又加得後月朔也。

translations.literal: Add again to obtain full moon; add again for last quarter; add again for the next month's new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add again for full moon, again for last quarter, and again for the following new moon.

sentences.zh: 推閏術：

translations.literal: Procedure for computing intercalation:
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for computing intercalation:

sentences.zh: 以閏餘減章歲，余滿閏法得一月，命以天正，算外，閏所在也。

translations.literal: Subtract intercalary remainder from rule years; when the remainder fills the intercalation factor, obtain one month; name from the civil new year, outside the count: where the intercalation lies.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract intercalary remainder from rule years; each time the remainder fills the intercalation factor you gain one month; count from civil new year (outside the count) to locate the leap month.

sentences.zh: 閏有進退，以無中氣為正。

translations.literal: Intercalations may advance or retreat; lack of a mid-climate is the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Leap placement may shift; the rule is that a month without a mid-climate is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 推二十四氣：

translations.literal: Procedure for computing the twenty-four qi:
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to compute the twenty-four qi:

sentences.zh: 置入上元年數算外，以餘數乘之，滿紀法為積日，不盡為小餘。

translations.literal: Set in the upper-origin year count, outside the count; multiply by remainder number; when full of era factor it makes accumulated days; what does not fill is small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Take years since upper origin (outside the count), multiply by remainder number, divide by era factor for accumulated days; the remainder is fractional day remainder.

sentences.zh: 六旬去積日，不盡為大餘。

translations.literal: Remove six decades from accumulated days; what does not fill is greater remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract sixty-day cycles from accumulated days; the remainder is greater remainder.

sentences.zh: 大餘命以甲子，算外，天正十一月冬至日也。

translations.literal: Name greater remainder from jiazi, outside the count: the winter solstice day of the eleventh civil month.
translations.idiomatic: Name greater remainder from jiazi (outside the count) for the winter solstice of civil month 11.

sentences.zh: 求次氣：

translations.literal: To seek the next qi:
translations.idiomatic: To find the next qi:

sentences.zh: 加大餘十五，小餘八千六百二十六，小分五。

translations.literal: Add to greater remainder 15; to small remainder 8,626; to small parts 5.
translations.idiomatic: Add 15 to greater remainder, 8,626 to small remainder, and 5 to small parts.

sentences.zh: 小分滿六從小餘，小餘滿紀法從大餘，命如前，次氣日也。

translations.literal: When small parts fill 6, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills era factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before: the next qi day.
translations.idiomatic: When small parts reach 6, carry to small remainder; when small remainder fills era factor, carry to greater remainder; name as before for the next qi.

sentences.zh: 求土王用事：

translations.literal: To seek the earth's kingly tenure:
translations.idiomatic: To find the earth phase (tu wang) period:

sentences.zh: 加冬至大餘二十七，小餘萬五千五百二十八，季冬土用事日也。

translations.literal: Add to winter-solstice greater remainder 27; to small remainder 15,528: the last month of winter when earth holds sway.
translations.idiomatic: Add 27 to winter-solstice greater remainder and 15,528 to small remainder for the late-winter earth tenure day.

sentences.zh: 又加大餘九十一，小餘萬二千二百七十，次土用事日也。

translations.literal: Again add to greater remainder 91; to small remainder 12,270: the next earth tenure day.
translations.idiomatic: Add again 91 to greater remainder and 12,270 to small remainder for the next earth tenure day.

sentences.zh: 推沒術：

translations.literal: Procedure for computing submergence:
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for computing submergence (mo):

sentences.zh: 以九十乘冬至小餘，以減沒分，滿沒法為日，不盡為日餘，命日以冬至，算外，沒日也。

translations.literal: Multiply winter-solstice small remainder by 90; subtract from submergence parts; when full of submergence factor it makes days; what does not fill is day remainder; name the day from winter solstice, outside the count: the submergence day.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply winter-solstice fractional remainder by 90, subtract from submergence parts; divide by submergence factor for days; the remainder is day remainder; count from winter solstice (outside the count) for the submergence day.

sentences.zh: 求次沒：

translations.literal: To seek the next submergence:
translations.idiomatic: To find the next submergence:

sentences.zh: 加日六十九，日餘三萬四千四百四十二，余滿沒法從日，次沒日也。

translations.literal: Add days 69; day remainder 34,442; when remainder fills submergence factor, carry to days: the next submergence day.
translations.idiomatic: Add 69 days and 34,442 to day remainder; when remainder fills submergence factor, carry to days for the next submergence.

sentences.zh: 日餘盡為滅。

translations.literal: When day remainder is exhausted, it is extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: When day remainder is exhausted, the cycle ends (mie).

sentences.zh: 推日所在度術：

translations.literal: Procedure for the sun's lodge at each day:
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the sun's daily lodge:

sentences.zh: 以紀法乘朔積日為度實，周天去之，余滿紀法為積度，不盡為度餘。

translations.literal: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by era factor to make degree dividend; remove circumference of heaven; when remainder fills era factor it makes accumulated degrees; what does not fill is degree remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by era factor for degree dividend; subtract circumference of heaven; quotient by era factor gives accumulated degrees; remainder is degree remainder.

sentences.zh: 命以虛一，次宿除之，算外，天正十一月朔夜半日所在度也。

translations.literal: Name from Void I; remove lodges in sequence, outside the count: the sun's lodge at midnight on the eleventh-month new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Name from lodge Void I, subtract successive lodges (outside the count) for the sun's lodge at midnight on month-11 new moon.

sentences.zh: 求次月：

translations.literal: To seek the next month:
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month:

sentences.zh: 大月加度三十，小月加度二十九，入虛去度分。

translations.literal: Long month: add 30 degrees; short month: add 29 degrees; when entering Void, remove degree parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add 30 degrees for a long month, 29 for a short month; when entering Void, subtract degree parts.

sentences.zh: 求行分：

translations.literal: To seek motion parts:
translations.idiomatic: To find motion parts:

sentences.zh: 以小分法除度餘，所得為行分，不盡為小分，小分滿法從行分，行分滿法從度。

translations.literal: Divide degree remainder by small-part factor; the obtained is motion parts; what does not fill is small parts; when small parts fill the factor, carry to motion parts; when motion parts fill the factor, carry to degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Divide degree remainder by small-part factor for motion parts; the remainder is small parts; carry when parts fill their factors.

sentences.zh: 求次日：加一度。

translations.literal: To seek the next day: add one degree.
translations.idiomatic: For the next day: add one degree.

sentences.zh: 入虛去行分六，小分百四十七。

translations.literal: When entering Void, remove motion parts 6 and small parts 147.
translations.idiomatic: On entering Void, subtract 6 motion parts and 147 small parts.

sentences.zh: 推月所在度術：

translations.literal: Procedure for the moon's lodge at each time:
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the moon's lodge:

sentences.zh: 以朔小餘乘百二十四為度餘，又以朔小餘乘八百六十為微分，微分滿月法從度餘，度餘滿紀法為度。

translations.literal: Multiply new-moon small remainder by 124 to make degree remainder; again multiply new-moon small remainder by 860 for minute parts; when minute parts fill month factor, carry to degree remainder; when degree remainder fills era factor, it makes degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply new-moon fractional remainder by 124 for degree remainder and by 860 for minute parts; carry minute parts into degree remainder, then degree remainder into degrees by era factor.

sentences.zh: 以減朔夜半日所在，則月所在度。

translations.literal: Subtract from the new-moon midnight solar lodge: then the moon's lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the new-moon midnight solar position to obtain the moon's lodge.

sentences.zh: 求次月：

translations.literal: To seek the next month:
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month:

sentences.zh: 大月加度三十五，度餘三萬一千八百三十四，微分七萬七千九百六十七，小月加度二十二，度餘萬七千二百六十一，微分六萬二千七百三十六，入虛去度也。

translations.literal: Long month: add 35 degrees, degree remainder 31,834, minute parts 77,967; short month: add 22 degrees, degree remainder 17,261, minute parts 62,736; when entering Void, remove degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Long month: add 35 degrees plus the listed remainders and minute parts; short month: add 22 degrees plus its listed parts; on entering Void, subtract degrees.

sentences.zh: 遲疾歷：

translations.literal: Slow-Fast sequence:
translations.idiomatic: Slow-Fast (chi ji) sequence:

translations.idiomatic: Open table bracket

sentences.zh: 推入遲疾歷術：

translations.literal: Procedure for entering the Slow-Fast sequence:
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to enter the Slow-Fast sequence:

sentences.zh: 以通法乘朔積日為通實，通周去之，余滿通法為日，不盡為日餘。

translations.literal: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by communication factor to make communication dividend; remove communication cycle; when remainder fills communication factor it makes days; what does not fill is day remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply new-moon accumulated days by communication factor for communication dividend; subtract communication cycle; divide by communication factor for days; remainder is day remainder.

sentences.zh: 命日算外，天正十一月朔夜半入歷日也。

translations.literal: Name the day, outside the count: the day entered in the sequence at midnight on the eleventh-month new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Name the day (outside the count) for midnight entry into the sequence on month-11 new moon.

sentences.zh: 求次月：

translations.literal: To seek the next month:
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month:

sentences.zh: 大月加二日，小月加一日，日餘皆萬一千七百四十六。

translations.literal: Long month: add 2 days; short month: add 1 day; day remainder in each case 11,746.
translations.idiomatic: Long month: add 2 days; short month: add 1 day; day remainder always 11,746.

sentences.zh: 歷滿二十七日，日餘萬四千六百三十一，則去之。

translations.literal: When the sequence fills 27 days and day remainder 14,631, then remove it.
translations.idiomatic: When the sequence reaches 27 days with day remainder 14,631, drop that cycle.

sentences.zh: 求次日：加一日。

translations.literal: To seek the next day: add one day.
translations.idiomatic: For the next day: add one day.

sentences.zh: 求日所在定度：

translations.literal: To seek the sun's fixed lodge at each day:
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's true (fixed) daily lodge:

sentences.zh: 以夜半入歷日餘乘損益率，以損益盈縮積分，如差率而一，所得滿紀法為度，不盡為度餘，以盈加縮減平行度及余為定度。

translations.literal: Multiply midnight sequence-entry day remainder by decrease-increase rate; by decrease-increase, adjust the accumulated surplus-deficit parts; as difference rate to one; when obtained fills era factor it makes degrees; what does not fill is degree remainder; add surplus and subtract deficit from mean degree and remainder for fixed degree.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply midnight sequence day remainder by the adjustment rate, apply surplus-deficit to accumulated parts, scale by difference rate; divide by era factor for degrees; add surplus or subtract deficit from mean solar degree for true position.

sentences.zh: 益之或滿法，損之或不足，以紀法進退。

translations.literal: When increasing fills the factor, or decreasing is insufficient, advance or retreat by era factor.
translations.idiomatic: If increase overflows the factor or decrease underflows, adjust by one era factor.

sentences.zh: 求度行分如上法。

translations.literal: To seek degree motion parts, use the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: Find degree motion parts by the same method.

sentences.zh: 求次日，如所入遲疾加之。

translations.literal: To seek the next day, add according to the slow or fast entered.
translations.idiomatic: For the next day, add according to whether the sequence entry is slow or fast.

sentences.zh: 虛去分，如上法。

translations.literal: When entering Void, remove parts as in the procedure above.
translations.idiomatic: On entering Void, subtract parts as above.

sentences.zh: 推入陰陽歷術：置通實以會周去之，不滿交數三十五萬八千八百八十八半為朔入陽歷分，各去之，為朔入陰歷分，各滿通法得一日，不盡為日餘。

translations.literal: Procedure for entering the Yin-Yang sequence: set communication dividend; remove conjunction cycle; when not full of conjunction number 358,888.5 it is new-moon entry into yang sequence parts; remove each in turn for new-moon entry into yin sequence parts; when each fills communication factor obtain one day; what does not fill is day remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To enter the Yin-Yang sequence: take communication dividend, subtract conjunction cycle; remainder under conjunction number 358,888.5 is yang-sequence entry for the new moon; subtract each portion for yin entry; divide by communication factor for days; remainder is day remainder.

sentences.zh: 命日算外，天正十一月朔夜半入歷日也。

translations.literal: Name the day, outside the count: the day entered in the sequence at midnight on the eleventh-month new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Name the day (outside the count) for midnight sequence entry on month-11 new moon.

sentences.zh: 求次月：大月加二日，小月加一日，日餘皆二萬七百七十九。

translations.literal: To seek the next month:
translations.idiomatic: To find the next month:

sentences.zh: 歷滿十三日，日餘萬五千九百八十七半，則去之。

translations.literal: Long month: add 2 days; short month: add 1 day; day remainder in each case 20,779.
translations.idiomatic: Long month: add 2 days; short month: add 1 day; day remainder always 20,779.

sentences.zh: 陽竟入陰，陰竟入陽。

translations.literal: When the sequence fills 13 days and day remainder 15,987.5, then remove it.
translations.idiomatic: When the sequence reaches 13 days with day remainder 15,987.5, drop that cycle.

sentences.zh: 求次日：加一日。

translations.literal: When yang ends, enter yin; when yin ends, enter yang.
translations.idiomatic: At yang's end one enters yin; at yin's end one enters yang.

sentences.zh: 求朔望差：以二千二十九乘朔小餘，滿三百三為日餘，不盡倍之為小分，則朔差數也。

translations.literal: To seek the next day: add one day.
translations.idiomatic: For the next day: add one day.

sentences.zh: 加一十四日，日餘二萬一百八十六，小分百二十五。

translations.literal: To seek new- and full-moon difference: multiply new-moon small remainder by 2,029; when full of 303 it makes day remainder; what does not fill, double it for small parts: that is new-moon difference number.
translations.idiomatic: For new/full moon correction: multiply new-moon fractional remainder by 2,029; divide by 303 for day remainder; double the remainder for small parts to get new-moon difference.

sentences.zh: 小分滿六百六從日餘，日餘滿通法為日，即望差數也。

translations.literal: Add 14 days; day remainder 21,186; small parts 125.
translations.idiomatic: Add 14 days, day remainder 21,186, and small parts 125.

sentences.zh: 又加之，後月朔也。

translations.literal: When small parts fill 606, carry to day remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, it makes days: that is full-moon difference number.
translations.idiomatic: When small parts reach 606, carry to day remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, convert to days for full-moon difference.

sentences.zh: 求合朔月食：置朔望夜半入陰陽歷及余，有半者去之，置小分三百三，以差數加之。

translations.literal: Add again for the next month's new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Add again for the following new moon.

sentences.zh: 小分滿六百六從日餘，日餘滿通法從日，日滿一歷去之。

translations.literal: To seek conjunction and lunar eclipse: set new- and full-moon midnight yin-yang sequence entry and remainder; when there is a half, remove it; set small parts 303; add the difference number.
translations.idiomatic: For conjunction and eclipse: take midnight yin-yang sequence entry and remainder at new/full moon, drop halves, set small parts 303, and add the difference number.

sentences.zh: 命日算外，則朔望加時入歷也。

translations.literal: When small parts fill 606, carry to day remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, carry to days; when days fill one sequence, remove it.
translations.idiomatic: Carry small parts into day remainder and day remainder into days; when days complete one sequence, subtract the cycle.

sentences.zh: 朔望加時入歷一日，日餘四千一百九十八，小分四百二十八以下，十二日，日餘萬一千七百八十八，小分四百八十一以上，朔則交會，望則月食。

translations.literal: Name the day, outside the count: then the sequence entry at the hour of new or full moon.
translations.idiomatic: Name the day (outside the count) for sequence entry at the instant of new or full moon.

sentences.zh: 求合朔月食定大小餘：令差數日餘加夜半入遲疾歷余，日餘滿通法從日，則朔望加時入歷也。

translations.literal: When new- or full-moon hour sequence entry is one day and day remainder 4,198 with small parts 428 or below, or twelve days with day remainder 11,788 and small parts 481 or above, at new moon there is conjunction; at full moon, lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If hour-entry is 1 day with remainder ≤4,198 and small parts ≤428, or 12 days with remainder ≥11,788 and small parts ≥481, new moon yields conjunction and full moon yields eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以入歷余乘損益率，以損益盈縮積分，如差法而一，以盈減縮加本朔望小餘為定小餘。

translations.literal: To seek the fixed greater and smaller remainders for conjunction and eclipse: let difference-number day remainder add to midnight slow-fast sequence remainder; when day remainder fills communication factor, carry to days: then sequence entry at the hour of new or full moon.
translations.idiomatic: For fixed remainders at conjunction/eclipse: add difference day remainder to midnight slow-fast remainder; carry into days when remainder fills communication factor.

sentences.zh: 益之或滿法，損之或不足，以日法進退日。

translations.literal: Multiply sequence-entry remainder by decrease-increase rate; by decrease-increase adjust accumulated surplus-deficit parts; as difference factor to one; subtract surplus and add deficit from the original new/full small remainder for fixed small remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply sequence remainder by adjustment rate, adjust surplus-deficit parts, scale by difference factor, then subtract surplus or add deficit from base new/full fractional remainder.

sentences.zh: 求合朔月食加時：以十二乘定小餘，滿日法得一辰，命以子，算外，加時所在辰也。

translations.literal: When increasing fills the factor or decreasing is insufficient, advance or retreat by the day factor.
translations.idiomatic: On overflow or underflow in adjustment, carry or borrow using the day factor.

sentences.zh: 有餘者四之，滿日法得一為少，二為半，三為太。

translations.literal: To seek the hour of conjunction and eclipse: multiply fixed small remainder by 12; when full of day factor obtain one double-hour; name from zi, outside the count: the double-hour of the event.
translations.idiomatic: For event hour: multiply fixed fractional remainder by 12, divide by day factor for double-hours; count from zi (outside the count).

sentences.zh: 又有餘者三之，滿日法得一為強，以強並少為少強，並半為半強，並太為太強。

translations.literal: When there is remainder, quadruple it; when full of day factor obtain one as minor, two as half, three as major.
translations.idiomatic: If remainder remains, multiply by four; each day-factor quotient gives minor (shao), half (ban), or major (tai) subdivisions.

sentences.zh: 得二者為少弱，以並少為半弱，並半為太弱，並太為一辰弱，以前辰名之。

translations.literal: When there is still remainder, triple it; when full of day factor obtain one as strong; combine strong with minor for minor-strong, with half for half-strong, with major for major-strong.
translations.idiomatic: Further remainder: multiply by three; quotients are strong (qiang); combine with prior subdivisions for compound labels.

sentences.zh: 求月去日道度：置入陰陽歷余乘損益率，如通法而一，以損益兼數為定。

translations.literal: When two are obtained, that is minor-weak; combine with minor for half-weak, with half for major-weak, with major for one double-hour weak; name by the preceding double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Two quotients yield minor-weak; combine upward through half-weak and major-weak to a full weak double-hour named from the prior hour.

sentences.zh: 定數十二而一為度。

translations.literal: To seek the moon's degrees from the solar path: set yin-yang sequence remainder, multiply by decrease-increase rate, as communication factor to one, by decrease-increase adjust the combined number for the fixed value.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar latitude: take yin-yang sequence remainder, multiply by adjustment rate, divide by communication factor, and adjust the combined number.

sentences.zh: 不盡四而一，為少、半、太。

translations.literal: Fixed number: twelve to one makes degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the fixed number by twelve for degrees.

sentences.zh: 又不盡者三而一，一為強，二為少弱，則月去日道數也。

translations.literal: What does not fill: four to one makes minor, half, and major.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder in quarters yields minor, half, and major subdivisions.

sentences.zh: 陽歷在表，陰歷在裏。

translations.literal: When still not filled, three to one: one is strong, two is minor-weak: that is the moon's degrees from the solar path.
translations.idiomatic: Further remainder in thirds: one gives strong, two minor-weak, completing lunar distance from the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 測景漏刻中星數：

translations.literal: Yang sequence is outside; yin sequence is inside.
translations.idiomatic: Yang sequence is outside the path; yin sequence inside.

translations.literal: Numbers for gnomon shadow, clepsydra graduations, and culmination stars:
translations.idiomatic: Gnomon, clepsydra, and culmination-star tables:

sentences.zh: 求昏明中星：各以度數如夜半日所在，則中星度。

translations.literal: To seek dusk, dawn, and culmination stars: in each case use the degrees as at midnight solar position, then the culmination-star degrees.
translations.idiomatic: For dusk, dawn, and culmination stars, apply the same degrees as at midnight solar position.

translations.idiomatic: Procedure to compute the five planets:

sentences.zh: 推五星術：置度實各以率去之，余以減率，其餘，如紀法而一，為入歲日，不盡為日餘，命以天正朔，算外，星合日。

translations.literal: Procedure for the five planets: set degree dividend; each remove its rate; from the remainder subtract the rate; the remainder, as era factor to one, is days entered in the year; what does not fill is day remainder; name from the civil new-year new moon, outside the count: day of planetary conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet: take degree dividend, subtract its rate repeatedly; treat the remainder over era factor as days since civil new-year new moon (outside the count) for conjunction day.

sentences.zh: 求星合度：以入歲日及余從天正朔日積度及余，滿紀法從度，滿三百六十餘度分則去之，命以虛一，算外，星合所在度也。

translations.literal: To seek the degree of conjunction: with days and remainder entered in the year, follow from civil new-year new-moon accumulated degrees and remainder; when remainder fills era factor, carry to degrees; when degrees fill 360, remove degree parts; name from Void I, outside the count: the degree where the planet conjoins.
translations.idiomatic: For conjunction degree: add year-entry days and remainder to new-year solar accumulated degrees; carry at era factor; drop full circles; name from Void I (outside the count).

sentences.zh: 求星日見：以術伏日及余加星合日及余，余滿紀法從日，命如前，見日也。

translations.literal: To seek the day of planetary appearance: add the computed concealment days and remainder to conjunction day and remainder; when remainder fills era factor, carry to days; name as before: day of appearance.
translations.idiomatic: For first visibility: add tabulated morning/evening concealment days and remainder to conjunction; carry remainder into days; name as before.

sentences.zh: 求星見度：以術伏度及余加星合度及余，余滿紀法從度，入虛去度分，命如前，星見度也。

translations.literal: To seek the degree of appearance: add computed concealment degrees and remainder to conjunction degree and remainder; when remainder fills era factor, carry to degrees; when entering Void, remove degree parts; name as before: degree of appearance.
translations.idiomatic: For appearance degree: add concealment degrees and remainder to conjunction position; carry; subtract on entering Void; name as before.

sentences.zh: 行五星法：以小分法除度餘，所得為行分，不盡為小分，及日加所行分，滿法從度，留者因前，逆則減之，伏不盡度。

translations.literal: Procedure for planetary motion: divide degree remainder by small-part factor; the obtained is motion parts; what does not fill is small parts; daily add the motion parts; when full of factor, carry to degrees; when stationary, follow the prior; when retrograde, subtract; when concealed, do not exhaust degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Planetary motion: convert degree remainder to motion and small parts; add daily motion; carry at factor; hold in station, subtract in retrograde; concealment may leave degrees unused.

sentences.zh: 從行入虛，去行分六，小分百四十七，逆往出虛，則加之。

translations.literal: When direct motion enters Void, remove motion parts 6 and small parts 147; when retrograde emerges from Void, then add them.
translations.idiomatic: On direct motion entering Void, subtract 6 motion parts and 147 small parts; add them when retrograde leaves Void.

translations.literal: At first in conjunction with the sun, concealed 16 days, day remainder 17,832, moving 2 degrees, degree remainder 37,504, morning appearance in the east.
translations.idiomatic: First conjunction with the sun: 16 days concealed (remainder 17,832), motion 2 degrees (remainder 37,504), then morning visibility in the east.

sentences.zh: 從，日行四分，百一十二日行十九度十一分。

translations.idiomatic: Prograde at four parts per day; in 112 days advances 19 degrees 11 parts.

sentences.zh: 逆，日行三分，八十六日退十一度五分。

translations.idiomatic: Retrograde at three parts per day; in 86 days retreats 11 degrees 5 parts.

sentences.zh: 又留二十八日。

translations.idiomatic: Stationary again for 28 days.

sentences.zh: 從，日行四分，百一十二日，夕伏西方，日度餘如初。

translations.literal: Prograde, daily motion four parts; in 112 days, evening concealment in the west; day and degree remainder as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Prograde at four parts per day; after 112 days, evening concealment in the west with initial day and degree remainders.

sentences.zh: 一終三百九十八日，日餘三萬五千六百六十四，行三十三度，度餘二萬五千二百一十五。

translations.literal: One cycle 398 days, day remainder 35,564, motion 33 degrees, degree remainder 25,215.
translations.idiomatic: One synodic cycle: 398 days (remainder 35,564), motion 33 degrees (remainder 25,215).

translations.literal: At first in conjunction with the sun, concealed 72 days, day remainder 608, moving 55 degrees, degree remainder 28,865, morning appearance in the east.
translations.idiomatic: First conjunction: 72 days concealed (remainder 608), motion 55 degrees (remainder 28,865), morning visibility east.

sentences.zh: 從，疾，日行十七分，九十二日行六十八度。

translations.literal: Prograde, fast, daily motion seventeen parts; in 92 days moves 68 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Prograde fast: seventeen parts per day; 92 days, 68 degrees.

sentences.zh: 小遲，日行十四分，九十二日行五十六度。

translations.literal: Slightly slow, daily motion fourteen parts; in 92 days moves 56 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Slightly slow: fourteen parts per day; 92 days, 56 degrees.

sentences.zh: 大遲，日行九分，九十二日行三十六度。

translations.literal: Very slow, daily motion nine parts; in 92 days moves 36 degrees.

translations.idiomatic: Stationary 10 days.

translations.idiomatic: Retrograde six parts per day; 64 days, retreat 16 degrees 16 parts.

translations.idiomatic: Stationary again 10 days.

translations.literal: Prograde, slow, daily motion nine parts; 92 days.
translations.idiomatic: Prograde slow: nine parts per day for 92 days.

translations.idiomatic: Evening concealment in the west; day and degree remainders as at first.

sentences.zh: 一終三百七十八日，日餘二千七百五十六，行十二度，度餘三萬一千七百九十八。

translations.literal: Slightly fast, daily one degree four parts; 92 days.
translations.idiomatic: Slightly fast: 1 degree 4 parts per day for 92 days.

sentences.zh: 大疾，日行一度五分，九十二日。

translations.literal: Very fast, daily one degree five parts; 92 days.
translations.idiomatic: Very fast: 1 degree 5 parts per day for 92 days.

sentences.zh: 晨伏東方，日度餘如初。

translations.literal: Morning concealment in the east; day and degree remainder as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Morning concealment east; day and degree remainders as at first.

sentences.zh: 一終五百八十三日，日餘三萬六千七百六十一，行星如之。

translations.literal: One cycle 583 days, day remainder 36,761; planetary motion the same.
translations.idiomatic: One cycle: 583 days (remainder 36,761); planetary motion matches.

sentences.zh: 除一周，定行二百十八度，度餘二萬六千三百一十三。

translations.literal: Remove one circuit; fixed motion 218 degrees, degree remainder 26,313.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract one circuit; net motion 218 degrees (remainder 26,313).

sentences.zh: 合二百九十一日，日餘三萬八千一百二十六，行星亦如之。

translations.literal: Conjunction 291 days, day remainder 38,126; planetary motion likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Conjunction half-cycle: 291 days (remainder 38,126); motion likewise.

sentences.zh: 水星：

translations.literal: Mercury:
translations.idiomatic: Mercury:

sentences.zh: 初與日合，伏，十四日，日餘三萬七千一百一十五，行三十度，度餘三萬七千一百一十五，夕見西方。

translations.literal: At first in conjunction with the sun, concealed 14 days, day remainder 37,115, moving 30 degrees, degree remainder 37,115, evening appearance in the west.
translations.idiomatic: First conjunction: 14 days concealed (remainder 37,115), motion 30 degrees (same remainder), evening west.

sentences.zh: 從，疾，日行一度六分，二十三日行二十九度遲，日行二十分，八日行六度二十二分。

translations.literal: Prograde, fast, daily one degree six parts; in 23 days moves 29 degrees; slow, daily twenty parts; in 8 days moves 6 degrees 22 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Prograde fast: 1 degree 6 parts per day, 23 days for 29 degrees; slow: twenty parts per day, 8 days for 6 degrees 22 parts.

sentences.zh: 留，二日。

translations.literal: Stationary, 2 days.
translations.idiomatic: Stationary 2 days.

sentences.zh: 遲，日行十一分，二日退二十二分，夕伏西方。

translations.literal: Slow, daily eleven parts; in 2 days retreats 22 parts; evening concealment in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Slow: eleven parts per day; 2 days, retreat 22 parts; evening concealment west.

sentences.zh: 伏八日，退八度，而與日合。

translations.literal: Concealed 8 days, retreats 8 degrees, then in conjunction with the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Concealed 8 days, retreat 8 degrees, then conjunction.

sentences.zh: 又八日退八度，晨見東方。

translations.literal: Again 8 days retreat 8 degrees, morning appearance in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Another 8 days retreat 8 degrees, then morning visibility east.

sentences.zh: 逆，日行十一分，二日。

translations.literal: Retrograde, daily eleven parts; 2 days.
translations.idiomatic: Retrograde eleven parts per day for 2 days.

sentences.zh: 留，二日。

translations.literal: Stationary, 2 days.
translations.idiomatic: Stationary 2 days.

sentences.zh: 從，遲，日行二十分，八日。

translations.literal: Fast, daily one degree six parts; 23 days.
translations.idiomatic: Fast: 1 degree 6 parts per day for 23 days.

sentences.zh: 疾，日行一度六分，二十三日。

translations.literal: Morning concealment in the east; day and degree remainder as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Morning concealment east; day and degree remainders as at first.

sentences.zh: 晨伏東方，日度餘如初。

translations.literal: One cycle 115 days, day remainder 34,739; planetary motion the same.
translations.idiomatic: One cycle: 115 days (remainder 34,739); motion matches.

sentences.zh: 一終百一十五日，日餘三萬四千七百三十九，行星如之。

translations.literal: One conjunction 57 days, day remainder 37,115; planetary motion likewise.
translations.idiomatic: One conjunction: 57 days (remainder 37,115); motion likewise.

sentences.zh: 一合五十七日，日餘三萬七千一百一十五，行星亦如之。

translations.literal: In a year of the upper origin, the year is in jiazi; civil new year, jiazi new moon, midnight winter solstice; sun, moon, and five planets gather at the beginning of the lodge Void; yin-yang, slow-fast likewise begin from this.
translations.idiomatic: At upper-origin year jiazi: civil new year jiazi new moon, winter solstice at midnight; sun, moon, and five planets at the start of Void; yin-yang and slow-fast sequences also begin here.

sentences.zh: 上元之歲，歲在甲子，天正甲子朔夜半冬至，日月五星聚於虛度之初，陰陽遲疾亦自此始。

translations.literal: In a year of the upper origin, the year is in jiazi; civil new year, jiazi new moon, midnight winter solstice; sun, moon, and five planets gather at the beginning of the lodge Void; yin-yang, slow-fast likewise begin from this.
translations.idiomatic: At upper-origin year jiazi: civil new year jiazi new moon, winter solstice at midnight; sun, moon, and five planets at the start of Void; yin-yang and slow-fast sequences also begin here.

sentences.zh: 梁武帝天監三年，沖之子恒上疏，論何承天歷乖謬不可用。

translations.literal: In the third year of Liang Emperor Wu's Tianjian reign, Chongzhi's son Heng submitted a memorial discussing the errors of He Chengtian's calendar, that it could not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Tianjian year 3: Zu Chongzhi's son Heng memorialized that He Chengtian's calendar was erroneous and unusable.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，詔用祖沖之所造《甲子元曆》頒朔。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict ordered the Jiazi Epoch Calendar Chongzhi had made to be used to issue the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, month 1, an edict adopted Zu Chongzhi's Jiazi Epoch Calendar for issuing the new moon.

sentences.zh: 陳氏因梁，亦用祖沖之歷。

translations.literal: Chen followed Liang and also used Chongzhi's calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Chen continued Liang practice and used Chongzhi's calendar.

sentences.zh: 至遼，聖宗以賈俊所進新歷，因宋《大明》舊號行之。

translations.literal: Reaching Liao, Emperor Shengzong took the new calendar Jia Jun presented and, keeping the old Song title Great Brightness, put it into use.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liao, Emperor Shengzong adopted Jia Jun's new calendar while retaining the Song name Great Brightness.

sentences.zh: 金曰《重修大明曆》。

translations.literal: Jin called it the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Jin titled it the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.

sentences.zh: 傳至皇元亦曰《重修大明曆》。

translations.literal: Transmitted to the Yuan it was also called the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuan it was likewise the Revised Great Brightness Calendar.

sentences.zh: 及改《授時曆》，別立司天監存肄之，每歲甲子冬至重修其法。

translations.literal: When the Season-Granting Calendar was adopted, a separate Directorate of Astronomy was established to preserve study; each jiazi year at winter solstice its methods were revised.
translations.idiomatic: After the Season-Granting Calendar replaced it, a Directorate of Astronomy kept the old methods, revised at each jiazi winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 書在太史院，禁莫得聞。

translations.literal: The book was kept in the Imperial Astronomical Archive; access was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The text remained in the Grand Astrologer's archive, barred from circulation.
